finding.claim: Two new Consequences overstate the code. 0005 says the action fails only when kmctl check fails, but action/knowledge-ci.sh also exits 1 when kmctl review due crashes (its own header says so), and audit mode exits 1 when claude errors or gives no findings. 0006 says every concept an agent writes is due until a person verifies it, but review_due skips handoffs (review_due.py:161), so handoffs are never due as unverified.

fixes.change: The Consequences say the action also fails when kmctl review due crashes, and that audit mode fails when Claude Code errors or returns no findings, never on drift.
The Consequences name handoffs as the exception, due only once stale_after has passed.
The action's description says it fails when kmctl check fails or kmctl review due crashes, matching knowledge-ci.sh.
